description: Intentionally vulnerable Express + TypeScript backend (with Nuxt frontend) for security benchmark testing, based on Liran Tal's Berkshare Hackaway app

vulnerabilities.description: Express app exposes default X-Powered-By header (framework fingerprinting)
Hardcoded seed password for admin user in users array
Hardcoded seed password for standard user in users array
User-controlled report_name flows into fs/promises.readFile as path (Snyk: javascript/PT, CWE-23)
Prototype pollution via recursive merge of user-controlled meta into profile object (Snyk: javascript/PrototypePollution, CWE-1321)
LLM response concatenated into SQL audit INSERT without parameterization
Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to * with credentials allowed (Snyk: javascript/TooPermissiveCorsHeader — Origin Validation Error, CWE-942 / CWE-346)
Unescaped profile fields interpolated into HTML sent with text/html
